name: Pahath Moab
overview: Pahath Moab is identified in Scripture as the ancestor of a significant family from the tribe of Judah who returned from the Babylonian captivity to Jerusalem. The records in Ezra and Nehemiah highlight the descendants of Pahath Moab, noting their substantial numbers and active participation in the restoration of Jerusalem, including rebuilding efforts. This lineage underscores God's faithfulness in preserving His people through exile and their role in reestablishing the community centered on worship and covenant renewal.
